history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Kentucky's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: Kentucky adopts State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: Kentucky's State Seal of Biliteracy was authorized in 2021 and is administered by KDE for high-school graduates proficient in English plus one or more world languages. Adoption postdates the Leider 2019 baseline and so was not captured there.
